raw_excerpt: Material for MkDocs. 'Documentation that simply works. Write your documentation in Markdown and create a professional static site in minutes – searchable, customizable, in 60+ languages, for all devices.' Features: Just Markdown (no HTML/CSS/JS knowledge needed), Works on all devices, Made to measure (colors, fonts, language, icons, logo), Fast and lightweight, Maintain ownership (no third-party platforms), Open Source (MIT). Built-in instant search, Code annotations, Social cards, 10,000+ icons and emojis. Trusted by NASA, CERN, TC39, W3C, Google, Microsoft, Mozilla, Font Awesome, Apache, freeCodeCamp.
